    Bug 2023613 - Let the "Move to New Tab" menuitem work again after changing "disabled" to HTML boolean style. r=mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D288607

diff --git a/mail/base/content/tabmail.js b/mail/base/content/tabmail.js
index 2044bedc6ca..f212d496e7d 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/tabmail.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/tabmail.js
@@ -1981,10 +1981,7 @@ window.addEventListener(
       }
 
       currentTabInfo = tabmail.tabInfo.find(info => info.tabNode == tabNode);
-      openInWindowItem.toggleAttribute(
-        "disabled",
-        currentTabInfo.canClose && tabmail.persistTab(currentTabInfo)
-      );
+      openInWindowItem.toggleAttribute("disabled", !currentTabInfo.canClose);
       closeOtherTabsItem.toggleAttribute(
         "disabled",
         tabmail.tabInfo.every(info => info == currentTabInfo || !info.canClose)
title: Bug 2023613 - Let the "Move to New Tab" menuitem work again after changing "disabled" to HTML boolean style. r=mkmelin
